messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content:
Upgraded to **`v0.6.1`**! Two improvements are now live:
1. **Newest Gemini Models + Selector**: Auto-tries `gemini-3-flash-preview` first, falling back to `gemini-2.5-flash` / `gemini-2.5-pro` (plus a live model dropdown & **⚡ Test Gemini** button right on the stage).
2. **Zero-Reload Hot Interceptor**: Attached a capture-phase listener inside `stage-custom.js` so even if Safari cached an older `app.js`, your chat messages immediately hit Gemini first!
